title: Wealth Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Nirmal Bang Wealth Pvt Ltd (NBWPL) is a comprehensive financial solutions provider serving market intermediaries and distributors of financial products across India. Supported by robust technology, NBWPL focuses on delivering high\-quality service and rewarding solutions that enable Business Associates to prioritize client needs. Its Financial Products Distribution arm has a strong network of approximately 4,500 Business Associates nationwide, reflecting steady growth. NBWPL offers a wide range of third\-party products, including Mutual Funds, AIFs, PMS, Sovereign Gold Bonds, NCDs, Corporate Fixed Deposits, and MLDs. As an AMFI and APMI registered distributor, NBWPL maintains extensive partnerships with all major Asset Management Companies in India, providing diverse investment options to clients.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Wealth Manager role based in Howrah. The Wealth Manager will be responsible for understanding clients’ financial goals, assessing their risk profiles, and designing tailored investment and financial planning strategies. Daily activities include advising on mutual funds, PMS, AIFs, insurance solutions, and other investment products, as well as monitoring portfolio performance and recommending rebalancing when appropriate. The role involves regular client meetings, preparation of investment proposals, reviewing market trends, and ensuring compliance with regulatory and organizational policies. The Wealth Manager will collaborate with internal teams and Business Associates to deliver high\-quality client service and support long\-term relationship building.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong skills in Financial Planning, including goal\-based planning, retirement planning, and tax\-efficient strategies.
* Proficiency in Investment Management and Investments, with the ability to construct and review diversified portfolios.
* Solid understanding of Finance principles, capital markets, and various financial instruments offered by NBWPL.
* Knowledge of Insurance products and their role in overall wealth and risk management for clients.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field; relevant certifications (e.g., CFP, NISM, AMFI) are an advantage.
* Strong analytical and numerical skills, with the ability to interpret market data and product information.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills to build trust\-based, long\-term client relationships.
* High ethical standards, customer\-centric mindset, and ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.

 Finance Director
   

  

**Finance Director**
**Town of Raymond**
 The Town of Raymond (est. pop. 11,000\) is seeking an experienced and detail\-oriented Finance Director to lead the Town’s Finance Department.
   

  

 This is a full\-time (40 hours/week), non\-union position responsible for directing the Town’s financial operations, including financial planning, accounting, budgeting, financial reporting, payroll, procurement, grants, debt, capital improvement programs, and risk management. The Finance Director works closely with the Town Manager, department heads, elected and appointed officials, auditors, financial institutions, and the public.
   

  

 The successful candidate must possess strong professional judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to maintain confidentiality. Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills are essential, as is the ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and effectively communicate complex financial information to a variety of audiences.
   

  

**Qualifications Preferred**
* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, public administration, or a related field; equivalent education and progressively responsible experience may be considered.
* Five (5\) years of progressively responsible accounting or financial management experience, preferably including municipal or governmental accounting.
* Municipal finance, budgeting, financial reporting, payroll, and/or governmental accounting experience preferred.
* Knowledge of applicable governmental accounting principles, municipal finance practices, budgeting, financial reporting, and regulatory requirements.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience supervising staff and coordinating the work of a Finance Department preferred.


 The Town of Raymond offers a competitive salary and benefit package.
   

  

 Salary: $85,000 – $110,000 annually, commensurate with qualifications and experience.
   

  

 The Town of Raymond is an equal opportunity employer.
   

  

 For additional information, contact the Town Manager at \[contact information].
   

  

**Full Job Description**
 Transmit a resume and cover letter, in confidence, as a PDF attachment to jjenks@raymondnh.gov.
   

  

 Resumes accepted until the position is filled.

title: Accounts Executive
description:
We are seeking a detail\-oriented Accounts Executive to join our team in West Bengal. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in accounting and be proficient in Tally ERP. As an Accounts Executive, you will be responsible for managing financial records, processing invoices, and ensuring compliance with accounting standards. Key Responsibilities: \- Maintain accurate financial records and ensure timely reporting of financial information. \- Process accounts payable and receivable transactions, including invoicing and payment processing. \- Reconcile bank statements and ensure that all transactions are accurately recorded. \- Assist in the preparation of financial statements and reports. \- Collaborate with other departments to ensure accurate financial data is maintained. \- Support audits by providing necessary documentation and information. \- Stay updated with accounting regulations and best practices to ensure compliance. Required Skills: \- Proficiency in accounting software, particularly Tally ERP. \- Strong understanding of accounting principles and practices. \- Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. \- Ability to work independently and as part of a team. \- Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. If you are a motivated individual with a passion for accounting and a desire to contribute to a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
   

  

 This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Senior Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Vikram Solar is one of India’s largest solar photovoltaic (PV) module manufacturers, with over 17 years of experience in the solar industry. The company has 9\.50 GW of installed manufacturing capacity for solar PV modules and is among the country’s leading pure\-play module manufacturers. As of June 30, 2025, Vikram Solar has 2\.85 GW of enlisted capacity under the Ministry of New \& Renewable Energy’s Approved List of Modules and Manufacturers (ALMM). The company has been repeatedly recognized as a Tier 1 manufacturer by BloombergNEF since 2014, reflecting its strong global credibility and performance. More information about the company and its products is available at vikramsolar.com.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Senior Executive role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Diamond Harbour\-II. The Senior Executive will oversee and coordinate daily operational activities, support strategic initiatives, and ensure that departmental targets and timelines are met. Responsibilities include monitoring performance metrics, preparing reports and presentations for leadership, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams such as production, quality, supply chain, and finance. The role involves maintaining compliance with internal policies and industry standards, identifying process improvement opportunities, and supporting the implementation of best practices. The Senior Executive will also participate in stakeholder communication, assist in project execution, and contribute to driving efficiency and growth in line with Vikram Solar’s business objectives.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong operational and administrative skills, including experience in coordinating cross\-functional activities and managing day\-to\-day processes.
* Analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to work with data, prepare MIS reports, dashboards, and performance summaries for management.
* Project coordination and stakeholder management skills, with experience in supporting project timelines, liaising with internal teams, and maintaining clear communication.
* Knowledge of manufacturing or renewable energy sector operations; exposure to solar PV or related industries will be an added advantage.
* Proficiency in MS Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and comfort with using enterprise systems or ERP platforms.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with attention to detail and a structured approach to documentation.
* Ability to work on\-site, collaborate effectively in a team environment, and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced setting.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Management, or a related field; relevant professional certifications or postgraduate qualifications are beneficial.
* Demonstrated integrity, problem\-solving mindset, and commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.
